            lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan zhing | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3975">kha mo ze'u zhes grags pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chu mig <lb n="1b3"/> pa chen po</rs> de | <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:">dpal rdza ra'i sa</rs>'i char ze'u'i rgyud du 'khrungs || dgung lo bco brgyad la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">dge bshes 'bre shes rab 'bar</rs> la mkhan po zhus nas rab du byon te <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3809">dge bshes khyung <lb n="1b4"/> rin chen grags</rs> la dbu tshad dang spyod phyogs brlabs shing zhar chos <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">rgya</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4206">stag</rs> gnyis la gsan skad | de nas mkhan po la pha rol du phyin pa lo drug gsan te mdo 'grel dang bcas pa <lb n="1b5"/> mtha' dag par mkhyen |</seg></TEI>
